description: This file defines enums and structs related to the icon state for a macOS application. It includes representations for session roles, tool kinds, activity kinds, icon states, badge prominence, and override selections, along with logic for determining symbol names, prominence, activity state, and conversions between override selections and icon states.

methods.name: badgeSymbolName
methods.description: Returns the system symbol name associated with the current icon state based on activity kind and tool type.

methods.name: badgeProminence
methods.description: Returns the prominence level of the badge depending on the icon state.

methods.name: isWorking
methods.description: Indicates whether the current icon state represents a working/activity state.

methods.name: toIconState
methods.description: Converts an override selection to a corresponding icon state.
